correctness.rationale: Dirichlet posterior moments have leading term beta^alpha/(n+A)^(rising k), and the multinomial factorial moments give n^(falling k) times x^alpha. Selfadjointness then diagonalizes the operator on the exact-degree spaces, with zero above degree n. For c=A/2 the centered factors are (N-j-c)/(N+j+c); twice the linear sum in the arctanh expansion is q_k and twice the cubic sum divided by three is D_k. The residual of -N log(lambda) is nonnegative, and for k<=n/2 it is bounded by C(k+1)^6/N^4. The centered Loewner bound follows before taking any limit. Taylor's inequality for e^(-v), v>=0, and the Gaussian decay of e^(-t q_k) give a summable O(N^-4) bound after the correction, including the complementary frequency tail. Direct summation of the p-th powers with the degree multiplicities works for p<1, and a supremum works for p=infinity. The limiting defect is nonzero since D_1=A^3/12. For the shifted clock one can apply the uniform centered estimate at tau=t(1+(s-c)/N) and differentiate H_tau in each ideal on a compact positive time interval; q_k^2 exp(-delta q_k/2) bounds the Taylor residual. This proves the asserted first-order limit also for shifts below c and shows uniqueness. The d=2 numerical example agrees with direct evaluation of the cubic-sum formula.
residual_risks: Fixed dimension and positive weights; bounds in time use compact subintervals of (0,infinity). The shifted clock needs n sufficiently large that its exponent is positive.
The order relation is Loewner, not pointwise positivity for fractional powers, and uniqueness is only among fixed additive shifts.

value.rationale: For the natural approximation of the Dirichlet diffusion by accelerated averaging, centering removes the first-order defect and leaves an explicit operator correction with a uniform fourth-order remainder in positive time windows. Trace class and smaller p quantify error across all modes, not just on individual functions, and the one-sided bound and positive leading constant explain when an additive clock can or cannot accelerate the approximation. This is a quantitative approximation statement beyond the already known interval special case.
residual_risks: The result does not optimize nonlinear clocks, address time approaching zero, or provide an independent result about dimension growing with degree.
